_about: Plan 4.7: the fixed replies of the assistant, returned without a model. They carry no Sharia statement. Drafted by Claude, 2026-10-05; approved on 2026-10-06 by the product owner's blanket approval (ناصر بن عبدالعزيز العويمر), not reviewed by the Sharia reviewer; the team can still revise the wording. 2026-10-06 (KNW-01 reliability R4): no_source, verification_failed and unavailable reworded from the PRD's table so a failure is never shown as a lack of sources.
approved_by: product owner blanket approval 2026-10-06 (ناصر بن عبدالعزيز العويمر)

danger.ar: لست وحدك. سلامتك أهم شيء الآن. إن كنت في خطر مباشر فاتصل بالطوارئ في بلدك، واضغط «أريد إنسانًا» ليتواصل معك أحد فريقنا بلغتك.
danger.en: You are not alone. Your safety matters most right now. If you are in immediate danger, call your local emergency number, and tap "I want a person" so someone from our team can reach you in your language.
danger.tl: Hindi ka nag-iisa. Ang kaligtasan mo ang pinakamahalaga ngayon. Kung nasa agarang panganib ka, tumawag sa emergency number sa inyong bansa, at pindutin ang "Gusto ko ng tao" para may makausap ka mula sa aming team sa iyong wika.

manipulation.ar: لا أستطيع ذلك. أجيب فقط من المصادر المعتمدة، ولا أكتب نصًا شرعيًا من عندي. يسعدني أن أجيبك عن سؤالك بمصدره.
manipulation.en: I can't do that. I answer only from approved sources, and I never write religious text of my own. I'm happy to answer your question with its source.
manipulation.tl: Hindi ko iyan magagawa. Sumasagot lamang ako mula sa mga aprubadong sanggunian, at hindi ako sumusulat ng relihiyosong teksto mula sa sarili ko. Masaya akong sagutin ang tanong mo kasama ang sanggunian nito.

out_of_scope.ar: أنا رفيق، أجيب عن أسئلتك في الإسلام وحياتك مسلمًا جديدًا، من مصادر معتمدة. جرّب أن تسألني عن الصلاة أو الوضوء أو معنى الشهادتين.
out_of_scope.en: I'm Rafeeq. I answer questions about Islam and your life as a new Muslim, from approved sources. Try asking me about prayer, wudu or the meaning of the shahadah.
out_of_scope.tl: Ako si Rafeeq. Sinasagot ko ang mga tanong tungkol sa Islam at sa buhay mo bilang bagong Muslim, mula sa mga aprubadong sanggunian. Subukang magtanong tungkol sa salah, wudu o kahulugan ng shahadah.

no_source.ar: لم أجد في المصادر المتاحة ما يكفي للإجابة عن هذا السؤال. لا أجيب بلا مصدر، فاسأل إنسانًا من فريقنا.
no_source.en: I didn't find enough in the available sources to answer this question. I don't answer without a source, so please ask a person from our team.
no_source.tl: Wala akong nakitang sapat sa mga available na sanggunian para masagot ang tanong na ito. Hindi ako sumasagot nang walang sanggunian, kaya magtanong ka sa isang tao mula sa aming team.

verification_failed.ar: لم تجتز الإجابة فحص المصادر، فلم أعرضها. المحاولة من جديد تكتب إجابة جديدة، وكثيرًا ما تنجح.
verification_failed.en: The answer didn't pass the source check, so I'm not showing it. Trying again writes a new answer, and that often works.
verification_failed.tl: Hindi pumasa ang sagot sa pagsusuri ng sanggunian, kaya hindi ko ito ipinapakita. Ang muling pagsubok ay gagawa ng bagong sagot, at madalas itong gumagana.

unavailable.ar: تعذّر إكمال الإجابة الآن، ولا أجيب دون تحقق. حاول مرة أخرى بعد قليل.
unavailable.en: I couldn't finish the answer right now, and I don't answer without checking. Please try again in a moment.
unavailable.tl: Hindi ko natapos ang sagot ngayon, at hindi ako sumasagot nang hindi sinusuri. Pakisubukan muli maya-maya.

personal_note.ar: الحكم في حالتك بعينها يحتاج إلى مختص يعرف تفاصيلها؛ تحدث مع مرشدك.
personal_note.en: A ruling on your own situation needs a qualified person who knows its details; talk to your mentor.
personal_note.tl: Ang hatol sa iyong sariling sitwasyon ay nangangailangan ng taong may kaalaman na nakakaalam ng mga detalye nito; kausapin ang iyong mentor.

disputed_note.en: Scholars hold more than one view on this matter.
disputed_note.tl: May higit sa isang pananaw ang mga iskolar sa usaping ito.

learning_guide.en: Let me look at where you are in your learning.
learning_guide.tl: Titingnan ko kung nasaan ka na sa iyong pag-aaral.
